query: 47‑year‑old male: among inpatients 42–52 with diabetes + acute HF, report % prevalence antidiabetic classes Insulin, Metformin, Sulfonylurea, DPP‑4, SGLT2, GLP‑1, TZD in first 24h vs final 12h, net change (pp).
final_sql: SELECT p.subject_id, ph.pharmacy_id, ph.poe_id, ph.starttime, lag(ph.drug) OVER (PARTITION BY p.subject_id ORDER BY ph.starttime) AS previous_drug, (ph.drug - previous_drug) / NULLIF(ph.doses_per_24_hrs, 0) AS pp FROM patients p JOIN prescriptions ph ON p.subject_id = ph.subject_id WHERE p.subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM diabetes_hf);
